name: Hero Prop
body:
School: conjuration (creation); Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Personal

Target: You

Duration: 5 minutes

DESCRIPTION

You conjure a +1 Magic jester’s prop (your choice of cards, orb, marotte, or pole). The prop appears in your hand and remains for 5 minutes or until you put it down. You may dismiss this prop as a free action.
